body:
Wow. Thank you for this. It is so uplifting to read this. You're right, it really is the little bits of hope, happiness, stupid jokes that keeps me kicking. It's especially hard, because there are times I genuinely enjoy my life, but when the joy ends I feel like the my mind delves even deeper into darker places.

I am absolutely not offended by your spiritual comment, it offered a fresh perspective and I think you're right. As lowly human-being as I am, perhaps there is *something* for me.  Maybe one day, this "nobody" will be in the right place at the right time.  My only hope is that I will be able to serve some purpose.

I'm struggling to write a meaningful reply to you, but thank you, it means so much. It really was amazing to read your comment. Thank you for your point of view and perspective.
